title: TAF10 Voltage-Band Violation -> SwitchingAction (notify operator)
description: Emitted only for a voltage-band violation — the measured voltage is outside the grid node's voltageMinV/voltageMaxV band. Under- and overvoltage need an operator decision rather than an automatic curtailment or load shift.

reason.value: TAF10 voltage-band violation: measured voltage outside the grid node's voltageMinV/voltageMaxV band
